title: Do You Think Goldfish Forget in 3 Seconds?
summary: Everyone has heard that goldfish forget everything in three seconds. Here is what experiments with real goldfish show.

beats.text: Everyone says goldfish forget everything in three seconds. Myth or fact? Pause and guess!
Picture a goldfish circling its bowl, greeting the same rock again and again.

beats.reveal: Myth! Goldfish can remember things for months, not seconds.

beats.text: Scientists rang a sound at every feeding. Soon the fish swam over at the sound alone.
So the myth says three seconds. Experiments say months.
Bonus fact: goldfish can even see ultraviolet light, which our eyes cannot.

visual.text: Goldfish can see ultraviolet light, which human eyes can't.
